title: feat(rest,plugin-hono-server,cloud-connection): ETag + 304 on metadata lists, uncached item reads, runtime/config and localization; db/meta Server-Timing on every timed response
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2iicG3J8Tm4HGyLQKH11co)_

Part of #27627 (Target 4: metadata caching headers + Server-Timing coverage)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

No contract review is owed: `packages/spec/src` has no non-test change in this PR.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 每次加载最先发出的几类读取（`/runtime/config`、`/auth/me/localization`、元数据类型列表、每个 `/meta/:type` 列表、以及 app/dashboard/doc/book 等不走缓存的单项）现在都带 `ETag` + `Cache-Control: private, no-cache`，内容没变时回 `304`；开了耗时头时每个响应都有 `db`、`meta`、`total` 三项。
- 为什么改：这些读取原来没有任何校验头，每次加载都整包重下；耗时头缺 `meta`、没跑 SQL 时缺 `db`，看不出时间花在哪。
- 风险与回滚：`ETag` 对“实际发出的内容”做哈希，权限不同的两个人拿到不同的 `ETag`，一个人的 `ETag` 不可能换到另一个人的内容；全部是 `private`，共享缓存不存。`metadata.enableCache: false` 照旧关闭 `/meta` 校验头。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/types/src/representation-validator.ts`（规则本身）和 `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 两条链的最后一步。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-representation-etag.test.ts`；或对任一 `/meta/:type` 带上返回的 `ETag` 作 `If-None-Match` 再请求一次，得到 `304`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On `main` the Console's first reads sent no validator at all, so every load downloaded them in full. Each of these now answers a weak `ETag`, `Cache-Control: private, no-cache`, and a bodiless `304` when `If-None-Match` names the current tag:

| route | owner |
|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta`, `GET /meta/types` (type list) | `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` |
| `GET /meta/:type` (every list) | `meta-collection-routes.ts` via the shared list chain `createMetaListAnswer` |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name` on the uncached exit (`app`, `dashboard`, `doc`, `book`, drafts, `?package=`, member-scoped reads) | `meta-item-read-routes.ts` via the shared item chain `createMetaItemAnswer` |
| `GET /auth/me/localization` | `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts` |
| `GET /runtime/config` | `packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-plugin.ts` |

**The validator hashes the body actually served**, after every per-caller step (read gates, the app filter, the field mask, translation, the host's environment). That is the invariant `getMetaItemCached` already states for the cached item door. It means no per-caller fold is needed: two callers whose gates differ are served different bytes and so hold different tags, and one caller's tag can never answer `304` for another caller's body. The rule lives once in `@objectstack/types` (`representationEtag`, `ifNoneMatchHits`, `REVALIDATE_PRIVATE_CACHE_CONTROL`), the only package the three owners share. The tag is two FNV-1a/32 lanes (16 hex chars) written `W/"…"`; `If-None-Match` is compared weakly per RFC 9110 §13.1.2 (lists, `*`, repeated headers).

- ⛔ No `public` anywhere: every body here is per caller, per host, or per locale.
- A schema served under an undetermined field visibility (ADR-0106 D6 tier 2) keeps `private, no-store` and gets no tag.
- `metadata.enableCache: false` (declared "Enable HTTP cache headers (ETag, Last-Modified)") switches the `/meta` validators off; the tier-2 `no-store` is still sent.
- `/runtime/config` stays anonymous; its payload never depends on who asked.

**Server-Timing** (gate unchanged: `OS_SERVER_TIMING=true`, or an admin's `X-OS-Debug-Timing: 1`):

- Every timed response carries `db` and `meta` beside `total`. A request that ran no SQL or read no metadata says so with a zero member (`db;dur=0;desc="0 queries"`), so "nothing spent" no longer reads like "not measured".
- The `/meta` routes count each metadata read into `meta` (`meta;dur=…;desc="N reads"`).
- `GET /runtime/config` opens the per-request gate for an admin who sends `X-OS-Debug-Timing`. It resolves the caller only when that header is sent, and a resolution failure leaves the gate closed and the payload unchanged.

The bundle route is untouched (sibling PR #28287).

## Step 1 reading (main 69ce01d7, HotCRM, seeded admin, 58 routes)

| class | ETag | Cache-Control | 304 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /runtime/config` | no | none | no |
| `GET /auth/me/localization` | no | none | no |
| `GET /meta`, `GET /meta/types` | no | none | no |
| `GET /meta/:type` lists, all 33 types | no | none | no |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name` cached items (object, view, page, action, report, …) | yes | `private, no-cache` | yes |
| `GET /meta/flow/:name` | yes | `private, no-cache` | 200 by design (engine `registration` read live beside the document) |
| `GET /meta/app/:name`, `/dashboard/:name`, `/doc/:name`, `/book/:name` | no | none | no |

**Correction to PR 1's claim:** the `app`, `dashboard`, `doc` and `book` item doors carried **no** `ETag` on `main`. They bypass the shared item cache by design (per-caller and per-deployment gates) and took an exit that set nothing. This PR gives that exit its own body-hash validator.

Server-Timing on `main`: `meta` on 0 of 58 routes; `db` only when SQL ran; `/runtime/config` emitted nothing for an admin because nothing resolved the caller.

**Branch re-measure** (same HotCRM, branch head before rebase): 58 of 58 routes carry a weak `ETag` and `private, no-cache`; 57 of 58 answer `304` on a resend (the flow item answers 200, unchanged and by design); `db`, `meta` and `total` on all 58 for the admin header, `/runtime/config` included.

## Tests

- `packages/types/src/representation-validator.test.ts` (10): tag shape and stability, weak comparison, lists, `*`, arrays.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-representation-etag.test.ts` (13): per list and item door, a tag is present, an unchanged body answers `304`, two callers with different gates (`studio.access` vs none, over an unpublished app) get different tags, same-gate callers share one, a change moves it; a member presenting a builder's tag is still refused `404`; `enableCache: false`; the tier-2 posture; both chains hash what they answer; `meta` marks.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/server-timing-seeded-marks.test.ts`: zero members on an idle request, measured members never doubled, present for an admin, absent for an unproven caller and without the gate.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints-localization.test.ts`: a tag with `Vary: Accept-Language`, `304`, two users never cross-revalidate, a language change moves the tag, the signed-out answer carries none.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/runtime-config-etag.test.ts` (7): tag, `304`, two hosts never cross-revalidate, no caller resolved without the timing header, gate opens for an admin only, a failed resolution leaves it closed.
- Three existing pins changed meaning and were rewritten, not removed: the "gated reads carry no ETag" pin (`meta-audience-plural.test.ts`), the dashboard uncached pin (`rest.test.ts`), and the parity reference's non-holder posture (`meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`).

**Ablation:** mutating the list chain to hash the pre-gate list (`metaRepresentationCaching(raw, cacheControl)`) turns exactly "two callers whose gate differs get different tags" red (1 failed / 12 passed); restored, blob identical to HEAD.

## Verification

**Final head `a3d481eb`** (seat note): on top of `6d31fbb1` it adds only the two seat-approved doc edits (`docs/OBSERVABILITY.md` Server-Timing members, `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` list validators) and a changeset round trip (types `minor` → back to `patch`, per ruling A: `Metadata-protocol: none` puts every package at patch). All 124 derived gates green on it; every check-run success or skipped. The readings below are on head `6d31fbb1` (main `53749673` merged in; 23 files, +991 / -34).

- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` → 94 commands, every one run with `</dev/null`, exit codes recorded first; `dispatch-gates --ran` → 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, all exit 0. The first sweep caught two, both fixed in `6d31fbb1`: `check:route-envelope` (the new send helper declared `{}`, and the localization / runtime-config bodies sent as call-site literals again so their bare-body counts stay where the ruled exemption pins them) and `check:test-source-alias` (cloud-connection aliases `@objectstack/observability` to source).
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:dts-closure` green on a full dts build (`turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'`) with the new `@objectstack/types` module in it.
- Type check: dts build of `types`, `rest`, `plugin-hono-server`, `cloud-connection`, `runtime` and their closure, 35/35 tasks; `tsc --noEmit` on cloud-connection and plugin-hono-server after the fix.
- Tests on the final head: `rest` 360 files / 7127 passed (351 skipped), `cloud-connection` 62 / 765, `plugin-hono-server` 36 / 457, `types` 35 / 846. `runtime` meta/timing suites (incl. the parity test) 31 files / 1451 before the gate fix, which touched no runtime or rest logic.
- `check-governed-merges --branch HEAD`: 0 of 23 paths governed, 1025 changed lines.
- Live: HotCRM on the workspace CLI, 58 routes, before (main) and after (branch), table above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Runtime dispatcher `/meta` twin** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`): it shares both chains, so it now answers `Cache-Control: private, no-cache` with no runtime code change. It sends **no `ETag` and no `304`**; the parity test pins the `Cache-Control` agreement between the two transports.
- Layered views (`/layers` paths) are untouched.
- `metadata.enableCache: false` is honored for the new validators.
- The PR 1 claim about the `app`/`dashboard`/`doc`/`book` doors is corrected above.
- `@objectstack/types` gains a new export, so the changeset bumps it alongside `rest`, `plugin-hono-server` and `cloud-connection`.
